title: Let a harness rerun land the candidate a failed landing retained
goal: A rerun of a harness mission re-verifies the candidate that a failed landing retained and lands it, instead of failing on the claim the first run left; a base test that is red on main no longer costs a second worker run.

reuse.searched: crates/susi-harness/src/adapter.rs (run_task, start_scoped_worktree, local_claim, worktree_is_committed, gate, accept) and docs/harness-runbook.md.
reuse.reason: The resume path reads the claim the native workflow already keeps and reuses the adapter's own gate and acceptance checks; no new state file, command or dependency.

integration.workflow: susi harness run (mission core-resume), native local workflow integrate

results.landing: native gate integrated the candidate (format, licenses, clippy, affected tests, task acceptance, doc-tests) after main's own lint and task-record failures were repaired under T-CLAUDE-412 and T-CLAUDE-413
results.live_proof: a rerun of the susi-commercial-apps mission commercial-landing-report landed its retained candidate through this path without another worker run
